svg.text: A human pilot works with AI tools. Hosted quality agents measure drift in the quality attributes and report it to the AI-Hub. The pilot takes action.
The pilot reads the drift in the AI-Hub and takes the action
Created and changed by the pilot
Measure the drift in each attribute, continuously
Not every drift has a recommendation.
The pilot decides what to do.
Next step: actionable observability through an MCP integration
connects the AI-Hub to the tools
the action runs where the work happens
outcome flows back into the AI-Hub
Today, the pilot acts in the tools by hand.
With MCP, the AI-Hub can carry out the chosen
The same pattern runs in every stage loop. Only the artifact, the quality attributes and the humans change.
